text_block_list.text: One day, when I went out into town――

text_block_list.name: Tokkou-fuku Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What business does an esteemed Tracen Academy Trainer have in a place like this, huh?! Ah?!

text_block_list.name: Tokkou-fuku Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Here to mock us? You underestimate us in "Dance Slave" and you're gonna get hurt, got it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Cut out the pathetic crap.

text_block_list.name: Tokkou-fuku Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are you butting in out of nowhere...――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I told ya not to get cocky with ordinary civilians, dammit!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokkou-fuku Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Back when I fought them, I'm pretty sure Dance Slave
was a much better team than this……?

text_block_list.name: Tokkou-fuku Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What the... Wh-Wh-Who the hell do you think you are...?!
Acting like you know everything...!

text_block_list.name: Tokkou-fuku Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on! That blaze... That sheer spirit...
Don't tell me this guy is
the "Raging Demon" Pocket herself...!?

text_block_list.name: Tokkou-fuku Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! The "Battle Roar Demon" as in...
the founding leader of the baddest, fastest crew, "L/Roars"?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You know who I am?
Then naturally, you "get" what that means, right...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: How I've "taken care of" every brawl that's ever picked with me――yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tokkou-fuku Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!!
S-Sorry for acting so rude, forgive meee~!
Perhaps intimidated by Jungle Pocket's fierce intensity, the Umamusume in delinquent coats fled in a hurry――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you okay?
choice_data_list: Your powerful shout really saved me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, when clowns try to pick a lame fight,
scaring the crap outta them like that works best.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Next time some punk gives ya trouble,
you stand tall and tell 'em off!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I used to lead a freestyle racing team
back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Just so you know, I'm completely different
from those tacky losers back there, got it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heh, as long as you get it, that's fine!
